capabilities: Copy the source HTML of a selection in reading view
Format the copied HTML with Prettier
Trigger the copy via an assignable hotkey command
extras: The README's Demo section is empty, so no visual walkthrough is included; installation via community plugin browser or manual file placement is documented.
problem: Reading view shows rendered output, so there is no built-in way to grab the underlying HTML of a selection.
summary: Plugin that copies the source HTML of selected elements in reading view to the clipboard, formatted with Prettier.
